injury.short_comment: Hachimura (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.
Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
